rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the kind reception given to a guest or newcomer.

example.english: Everyone gave the new colleague a warm welcome on their first day at work.
example.traditional: 新同事第一日返工，大家畀佢一個熱烈嘅歡迎。
example.jyutping: san1 tung4 si6 dai6 jat1 jat6 faan1 gung1 daai6 gaa1 bei2 keoi5 jat1 go3 jit6 lit6 ge3 fun1 jing4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when you are glad to accept suggestions, ideas, or other input.

example.english: We welcome any new ideas you have.
example.traditional: 你有咩新諗法，我哋都歡迎。
example.jyutping: nei5 jau5 me1 san1 nam2 faat3 ngo5 dei6 dou1 fun1 jing4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a visitor or guest who is gladly received or for something people are happy to accept.

example.english: Your warm hospitality made me feel very welcome.
example.traditional: 你哋嘅熱情招待令我覺得好受歡迎。
example.jyutping: nei5 dei6 ge3 jit6 cing4 ziu1 doi6 ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 hou2 sau6 fun1 jing4

rows.note: This is the natural casual greeting for a friend or guest who has just arrived.
This is the all-purpose equivalent, especially when explicitly welcoming someone or introducing them to a place or situation.

example.english: We welcome you to our group.
example.traditional: 歡迎你加入我哋個群組。
example.jyutping: fun1 jing4 nei5 gaa1 jap6 ngo5 dei6 go3 kwan4 zou2

rows.note: Use this set phrase when welcoming customers into a shop, restaurant, or other business.
Use this for news, events, or changes that produce gladness rather than for someone being admitted or received.

example.english: This good news is truly welcome.
example.traditional: 呢個好消息真係令人開心。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 hou2 siu1 sik1 zan1 hai6 ling6 jan4 hoi1 sam1

rows.note: Use this permission pattern when someone is free to use or enjoy something without payment or special restriction.

example.english: You are welcome to help yourself to it.
example.jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 ceoi4 bin6 lo2 lai4 sik6
